text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Gimlet-san? Staring at the fence... 
Wait, don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!! Now, pass down the tale! This 
is a passion fiercer than the boiling 
flames of Mount Etna!
(CRACK-SQUELCH!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. I really cannot understand 
those Central Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
And you repair the fences you break 
yourself. ...Then why do you break them in 
the first place...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Do you not know what Shiva 
presides over? This is proof of my 
existence. Only through rebirth am I 
truly... myself.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...So you do have convictions, at least. 
*Sigh*... I'll help you repair it."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho... offering compassion, are you? We are 
Troy and Achaea—destined never to 
intertwine. Or so I thought you believed?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I have no intention of making friends 
with URA Umamusume. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"If you work over there, it might 
interfere with training. I just want to 
clear it out first."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Thanks for the food~

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Mayano-san. You still have some 
Japanese mustard spinach left, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmm... But it's bitter.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Good grief... This is why Central 
Umamusume are so..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Please wait just a moment. I'll show you 
the true potential of komatsuna.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's bit—ter... wait, it's not!? It 
actually tastes great! How come!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't you think? That's because—it's 
komatsuna grown in Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi is a major producer of 
komatsuna, and you can harvest delicious 
komatsuna year-round, even outside of 
winter. This is entirely thanks to 
Funabashi City's—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see~. But, the origin is one thing, 
but... Ehehe! Maya figured it out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You paid special attention to the 
seasoning and everything just for Maya, 
right? —Thank you, Furioso-san!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Eek! Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry, Furioso-senpai~! I wasn't 
looking ahead... Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine, but... are you all right, 
Dants-san? What's the rush?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Collecting printouts and stuff? 
I've got a bit of a backlog with my 
chores...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Still, since I took it on, I have to do 
my best. Well then! See you—”

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Seriously. This is why I can't stand 
Central Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'll help you with your work. Please give 
me instructions on where to start."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, no, no! I couldn't possibly 
accept something like that~!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, there is no need for you to worry. 
This is simply a matter of efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's faster with two people than doing it 
alone— that's obvious, isn't it? That's 
all there is to it.

One day, I saw Furioso heading toward the 
school gates with sweets in both hands.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...The strawberry frappe was from 
Mayano-san. And the taiyaki was from 
Dants-san.

"According to her, she received it as a 
thank-you for helping them out. 
Apparently, Tanino Gimlet is also treating 
her to a mocktail tonight—"
choice_data_list:
You're so nice to the Central girls too, 
good job!

You're so nice to the Central girls too, 
good for you!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I... I had no intention of being kind! 
None whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I am here as a representative of 
Funabashi. That is why I simply acted in a 
way not to bring shame upon it..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this isn't out of pure 
kindness... It's meant to make me let my 
guard down—yes! She's trying to make me 
drop my guard!
choice_data_list: I see, so that's the strategy... Smart!

I see, so that's the strategy... Pretty 
clever!

...No, maybe it's just that you're such a 
good kid?

...No, maybe it's just that you're such a 
good girl?

guard down—yes! She's trying to make me 
drop my guard!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Fufun. Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If we keep this up, their guard will 
gradually drop— and that's when we strike!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's why, from now on, I'll keep 
catching the URA Umamusume off their 
guard!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Wh... Trainer?!
choice_data_list:
Regardless of position, I just couldn't be 
cold to them.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, it can't be helped, can it? Once 
you talk to them, they're all such good 
girls..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Kh... If only everyone in the URA were 
bigger jerks...!!
